title: Compliance policy has no mark device noncompliant action

report.title: {Items.Count} assigned Windows compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy never marks', 'policies never mark')} a device non-compliant

messages.businessImpact: Requirements are measured but the device is never marked non-compliant, so Conditional Access that depends on compliance never acts.
messages.technicalDetail: Graph names the Mark device noncompliant action as block. Retire and wipe without block still raise here.
remediation: Add a Mark device noncompliant action with a short grace period, and prefer a notification action ahead of it.
messages.cannotSee: Graph names the action block. Retire and wipe without block still raise here. Settings Catalog compliance is unread. An unassigned policy is filtered out by where.
